# `edit.symmetrize`: Symmetrize

Makes a mesh mirror-symmetric: keeps one half and replaces the other with its mirror image, welded at the seam.

- Category: edit
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(V + F + C) plus the seam weld, O(n log n) in seam vertices
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: symmetrize, mirror mesh, make symmetric, polyMirrorFace, symmetry

The mesh is cut at the plane through the object origin normal to `axis`, the kept half (positive by default: +X is the right side) is mirrored onto the other side and seam vertices within `weld` are merged. Mirrored faces are `<label>.mirrored` and keep their groups.

**Use for** characters, vehicles, weapons and props that should be exactly symmetric after editing one side. The object origin must lie on the symmetry plane (`scene.set_origin` first if needed).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | `AxisParam` | `"x"` | Mirror across the plane through the origin normal to this axis. |
| `keep_positive` | `boolean` | `true` | Keep the positive half (default) and mirror it onto the negative one; false does the opposite. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |
| `weld` | `Length` | `0.0001` | Vertices this close to the plane weld into the seam. |

## Examples

```json
{"axis":"x","target":"post"}
```

Result: `post (o:3): mirrored the +X half onto -X (16 faces); welded 10 seam vertices; group symmetrize_1.mirrored`
